description: Living declarative registry of all 3rd-party companion applications, runtime utilities, system services, and libraries consumed by knot-mesh.

headless_qt6_offscreen.name: Headless Qt6 Crash Invariant
headless_qt6_offscreen.summary: Mandate QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen for all Qt6/KDE CLI probes in headless, SSH, or background contexts to avoid SIGABRT / exit code 134.

krdp_patcher_abi.name: KRdp Patcher ABI Invariant
krdp_patcher_abi.summary: Prevent stale /usr/local/lib/knot-vmon/libKRdp.so library mismatches when system krdp package upgrades. Patcher must verify matching ABI.
krdp_patcher_abi.rule: Audit system libKRdp.so.6 version before launching patched wrapper

deskflow_ini_dialect_bridge.name: Deskflow 1.26 vs 1.27 INI Dialect Bridge
deskflow_ini_dialect_bridge.summary: Deskflow 1.26 uses legacy 4-section Synergy syntax; Deskflow 1.27 uses QSettings INI. Knot bridges both via externalConfigFile pointer.
deskflow_ini_dialect_bridge.rule: Maintain externalConfig=true in Deskflow.conf pointing to compiled deskflow-server.conf

jq_dependency_packaging.name: Jq Dependency Packaging Invariant
jq_dependency_packaging.summary: jq is ubiquitous across knot-mesh core modules, auth, hub, council, and tests. It must be strictly declared in PKGBUILD depends and install.sh required_cmds.
jq_dependency_packaging.rule: depends+=('jq>=1.6') in PKGBUILD and required_cmds+=('jq') in install.sh

controlmaster_108_byte_safety.name: ControlMaster 108-Byte Socket Path Safety
controlmaster_108_byte_safety.summary: Linux kernel sockaddr_un.sun_path limit is 108 bytes. Knot enforces ControlPath cm_%C (40-char SHA1 hash) to guarantee zero path overflow.

sockets_fallback_cascade.name: Sockets Fallback Cascade
sockets_fallback_cascade.summary: Sub-second port probing and SSH ProxyCommand bridge cascades from nc -> socat -> /dev/tcp to ensure zero-failure connectivity on handhelds lacking netcat.
sockets_fallback_cascade.rule: Check nc, then socat, then bash /dev/tcp fallback

login_shell_ssh_promotion.name: Login Shell SSH Promotion
login_shell_ssh_promotion.summary: Non-interactive SSH commands must execute via bash -lc to source user profiles (~/.bash_profile, ~/.profile) and expose %h/.local/bin in PATH.

deskflow.name: Deskflow
deskflow.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Deprecation of externalConfig/externalConfigFile directive in Deskflow.conf; CLI argument changes between deskflow-core and deskflow; libportal InputCapture session revocation. File citations: PKGBUILD:16, install.sh:45-47, core/modules/deskflow.sh:10-753, core/modules/compile_deskflow.py:1-269, systemd/knot-deskflow.service:1-19, bin/knot:784-870.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.historical_notes: Predecessor to Deskflow (fork of Synergy). Lacks native Wayland InputCapture protocol support under Plasma 6; superseded by Deskflow. Fully purged from runtime codebase, build scripts, and documentation.
barrier.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Lacks native Wayland InputCapture protocol support under Plasma 6; superseded by Deskflow. Historical predecessor purged across codebase and documentation.

synergy.name: Synergy
synergy.historical_notes: Proprietary/legacy X11 KVM software. Requires X11/XTest and lacks modern Wayland InputCapture support; superseded by Deskflow. Fully purged from runtime codebase and documentation.
synergy.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Proprietary/legacy dialect fork; requires X11/XTest. Superseded by Deskflow; historical predecessor purged across codebase and documentation.

input_leap.name: Input Leap
input_leap.historical_notes: Wayland fork of Barrier. Superseded by Deskflow as Knot Mesh's unified KVM engine; dead process cleanup and legacy units purged from codebase.
input_leap.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Process conflict with deskflow-core; superseded by Deskflow. Legacy service cleanup fully retired from core/modules/deskflow.sh.

krdp.name: KRdp Server
krdp.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Upstream plasma/krdp#47 hardcoded metadata cursor mode breaking client cursor visibility; system libKRdp.so.6 upgrade breaking LD_LIBRARY_PATH patch wrapper in /usr/local/lib/knot-vmon. File citations: PKGBUILD:27, core/modules/vmon.sh:4, 51, 94-99, 177-216, bin/knot-vmon-patch-krdp:1-126.

krdc.name: KRDC Client
krdc.high_risk_breaking_triggers: CLI argument drift (--fullscreen %u); krdcrc config structure shifts in [hostpreferences]; fullscreen window management under KWin. File citations: PKGBUILD:28, core/modules/vmon.sh:55, 102-107, 230-234, 262-308, bin/knot-vmon-keepalive:4, 106-135.

freerdp.name: FreeRDP
freerdp.high_risk_breaking_triggers: FreeRDP 2 -> 3 certificate storage layout change (~/.config/freerdp/server/<ip>_<port>.pem); untrusted cert dialog interactive blocking. File citations: PKGBUILD:29, core/modules/vmon.sh:259-261.

wayvnc.name: wayvnc
wayvnc.historical_notes: VNC server targeting wlroots zwlr_screencopy_v1 protocol exclusively. Incompatible with KDE Plasma 6 KWin screencasting; superseded by KRdp Server and KRDC.
wayvnc.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Only compatible with wlroots compositors supporting zwlr_screencopy_v1; incompatible with KDE Plasma 6 KWin screencast. Superseded by KRdp / KRDC.

sunshine.name: Sunshine
sunshine.historical_notes: GameStream host server requiring cap_sys_admin+ep root capabilities for KMS screen capture or dummy display dongles. Superseded by native KWin headless virtual displays and KRdp/KRDC RDP streaming without elevated capabilities.
sunshine.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Requires cap_sys_admin+ep for KMS capture under Wayland or dedicated virtual display dummy driver; knot-mesh utilizes KRdp/KWin screencast instead. File citations: display-ops skill.

kscreen_doctor.name: kscreen-doctor
kscreen_doctor.high_risk_breaking_triggers: JSON output structure changes in -j flag; output.<name>.priority vs primary output handling under Plasma 6. File citations: PKGBUILD:21, core/installer/display.sh:13-82, 146-153, core/modules/vmon.sh:324-327, 473, 481, 492, 496, 518.

wlr_randr.name: wlr-randr
wlr_randr.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Regex parsing failures when scale is integer vs float; only operates under wlroots Wayland compositors. File citations: PKGBUILD:22, core/installer/display.sh:84-105, 155-162.

drm_info.name: drm_info
drm_info.historical_notes: Direct DRM/KMS node debugging utility. Useful for low-level GPU diagnostics, but never integrated into Knot Mesh runtime automation; superseded by kscreen-doctor and KWin D-Bus APIs.
drm_info.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Requires direct GPU node access (/dev/dri/card*); diagnostic only.

vkms.name: VKMS (Virtual Kernel Modesetting)
vkms.historical_notes: Virtual Kernel Modesetting test driver requiring root modprobe privileges and manual DRM pipeline configuration. Superseded by zero-root KWin headless virtual monitors and kscreen-doctor.
vkms.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Requires root modprobe privileges and kernel DRM arbitration; knot-mesh bypasses vkms by using KWin native virtual monitor creation.

evdi.name: EVDI (Extensible Virtual Display Interface)
evdi.historical_notes: DisplayLink Extensible Virtual Display Interface out-of-tree kernel module. Prone to frequent DKMS compilation breakages across rolling Linux kernel upgrades. Superseded by native user-space KWin headless virtual display allocation via kscreen-doctor and KWin D-Bus.
evdi.high_risk_breaking_triggers: DKMS compilation failures on newer Linux kernels; out-of-tree module required. Knot-mesh avoids EVDI in favor of KWin headless screencasting.

libportal.name: libportal
libportal.high_risk_breaking_triggers: InputCapture API 1 vs API 2 ABI compatibility; shim upgrade logic in core/shim/input_capture_shim.c; session restore token persistence. File citations: PKGBUILD:17, core/shim/input_capture_shim.c:9-152, core/modules/deskflow.sh:466.

libei.name: libei / libeis
libei.high_risk_breaking_triggers: EIS socket path negotiation changes under KWin (/org/kde/KWin/EIS/InputCapture); barrier array tuple signature changes in enable method. File citations: core/shim/input_capture_shim.c:236-392, core/modules/doctor.sh:91.

xdg_desktop_portal.name: xdg-desktop-portal
xdg_desktop_portal.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Unclean restart during active KWin EIS grab causes desktop session input freeze; systemd start ordering vs backend portal daemon. File citations: systemd/knot-deskflow.service:4-5, core/modules/deskflow.sh:569, 715-721, core/modules/doctor.sh:91-105.

xdg_desktop_portal_kde.name: plasma-xdg-desktop-portal-kde
xdg_desktop_portal_kde.high_risk_breaking_triggers: D-Bus notification spam on session restore; systemd unit activation order race condition with xdg-desktop-portal.conf. File citations: systemd/knot-deskflow.service:4-5, core/modules/deskflow.sh:358-382, 714-721, core/modules/doctor.sh:107-143.

openssh.name: OpenSSH
openssh.high_risk_breaking_triggers: ControlPath 108-byte sockaddr_un buffer overflow if %C hash is replaced by long paths; sshd_config.d drop-in support requirement; deprecation of legacy RSA keys. File citations: PKGBUILD:13, install.sh:36, core/modules/ssh.sh:14-293, bin/knot:385, 587, 726, 747, tests/test_exec_parallel.sh:28-120.

rsync.name: Rsync
rsync.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Argument parsing shifts between --protect-args and --old-args on whitespace paths; absence on minimal handhelds mitigated by streaming tar fallback. File citations: core/modules/swarm_sync.sh:61-120, bin/knot:2047-2056, tests/test_swarm_sync.sh:96-160.

socat.name: Socat
socat.high_risk_breaking_triggers: SYN timeout hang if connect-timeout parameter is omitted; STDIO socket bridging syntax. File citations: core/resolver.sh:124, 300, 360, docs/RELEASES_DIFF_LEDGER.md:439.

netcat.name: Netcat (nc)
netcat.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Flag incompatibility between openbsd-netcat (-z -n -w) and gnu-netcat (rejects combined -z -n -w); absent on stock SteamOS baseline reference. File citations: core/resolver.sh:116-121, 298, 357, bin/knot:419-422.

wireguard_tools.name: WireGuard Tools
wireguard_tools.historical_notes: Evaluated in early mesh architecture roadmaps as a kernel VPN overlay (wg0). Demoted and purged from architecture because Knot Mesh operates over direct local LAN with dynamic mDNS/ARP resolution (core/resolver.sh) and end-to-end encrypted OpenSSH ControlMaster multiplexing (core/modules/ssh.sh), eliminating TUN/TAP interfaces, iptables/nftables firewall rules, and out-of-band key coordination.
wireguard_tools.high_risk_breaking_triggers: wg-quick firewall backend requirement (iptables vs nftables); silent tunnel freeze behind NAT unless PersistentKeepalive=25 is set. Early roadmap overlay superseded by 3-tier resolver.

tailscale.name: Tailscale
tailscale.historical_notes: Evaluated in early mesh networking roadmaps (docs/SWARM_VISION_AND_ROADMAP.md). Superseded by native point-to-point OpenSSH ControlMaster encrypted multiplexing (core/modules/ssh.sh) and dynamic 3-tier local peer resolution (core/resolver.sh), avoiding external coordination servers, userspace TUN overhead, and tailscale0 interface requirements.
tailscale.high_risk_breaking_triggers: JSON schema drift in tailscale status --json; userspace networking mode lacking tailscale0 interface. File citations: docs/SWARM_VISION_AND_ROADMAP.md:24.

kdeconnect.name: KDE Connect
kdeconnect.high_risk_breaking_triggers: qdbus vs qdbus6 tool renaming; org.kde.kdeconnect.daemon.devices D-Bus method signature drift (takes 2 bools in modern releases); network refresh terminating active Virtual Monitor streams. File citations: PKGBUILD:26, systemd/knot-kdeconnect-reconcile.service:1-12, core/modules/kdeconnect.sh:19-1231, core/modules/vmon.sh:68-836.

syncthing.name: Syncthing
syncthing.historical_notes: Evaluated for peer-to-peer directory replication. Superseded by lightweight rsync over SSH and tar streaming in core/modules/swarm_sync.sh, avoiding background daemon resource overhead and sync lock contention.
syncthing.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Config XML schema version drift; .stfolder marker requirement causing stopped states on clean git clones; public relay leak if globalAnnounce is not disabled.

iproute2.name: iproute2
iproute2.high_risk_breaking_triggers: ip -o link show syntax changes; ss listening socket table output parsing in knot doctor. File citations: PKGBUILD:15, install.sh:36, core/lib.sh:138, core/modules/doctor.sh:220.

kitty.name: Kitty
kitty.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Remote control permission security changes (allow_remote_control=yes vs socket-only); IPC socket path permissions under /tmp. File citations: core/modules/council.sh:538-1189, runtime/skills/swarm-council/scripts/confluence.py:147-395, core/hub/limit_visualizer.py:540-558.

kitty_terminfo.name: kitty-terminfo
kitty_terminfo.high_risk_breaking_triggers: SSH into remote nodes from Kitty terminal fails with 'unknown terminal: xterm-kitty' unless terminfo is deployed. File citations: PKGBUILD:31.

ncurses.name: ncurses
ncurses.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Terminfo format incompatibilities across custom terminal descriptions. File citations: PKGBUILD:30.

bash.name: GNU Bash
bash.high_risk_breaking_triggers: macOS /bin/bash 3.2 lacks parameter case conversion (${var,,}) and associative arrays (declare -A); non-interactive SSH dispatch requires bash -lc. File citations: 100% of core/modules/*.sh, bin/knot, install.sh.

python.name: Python 3
python.high_risk_breaking_triggers: PEP 585 / PEP 604 type syntax (dict[str, Any] | None); removal of deprecated standard libraries in Python 3.14; PSL AST integrity check prohibiting swallowed exceptions. File citations: PKGBUILD:10, install.sh:36, core/palette.py, core/hub/*.py, core/mcp/*.py, bin/knot-stripd.

python_pyqt6.name: PyQt6
python_pyqt6.high_risk_breaking_triggers: QtQuick / QML plugin loading failures in wayland layer shell environments; knot-stripd GUI execution. File citations: PKGBUILD:11, bin/knot-stripd:34-36.

layer_shell_qt.name: layer-shell-qt
layer_shell_qt.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Wayland layer-shell protocol version mismatch causing window surface binding failure. File citations: PKGBUILD:12, bin/knot-stripd.

jq.name: jq
jq.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Missing in PKGBUILD depends and install.sh required_cmds; usage of advanced filters (.. | objects, @tsv, to_entries[]?) across lib.sh, auth.sh, council.sh, and hub.sh fails immediately on minimal hosts without jq. File citations: core/lib.sh:242, core/modules/auth.sh:138, core/modules/hub.sh:237, core/modules/council.sh:173.

systemd.name: systemd
systemd.high_risk_breaking_triggers: %h user-home specifier expansion in ExecStart directives; systemd-run --user --pipe environment isolation; journalctl --user-unit streaming in strip daemon. File citations: systemd/knot-*.service, core/modules/antigravity.sh:101-108, core/hub/agent.py:476.

pacman.name: pacman
pacman.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Pacman 7.0 download engine refactor; mirrorlist distribution over swarm sync. File citations: install.sh:54, core/modules/swarm_sync.sh:607-674, PKGBUILD.

flatpak.name: Flatpak
flatpak.high_risk_breaking_triggers: flatpak permission-set kde-authorized table format shifts; permission db corruption. File citations: core/modules/deskflow.sh:384-389, core/modules/doctor.sh:966-972.

ostree.name: OSTree
ostree.historical_notes: Evaluated as an architectural baseline reference for SteamOS A/B read-only root filesystem immutability. Knot Mesh guarantees 100% user-space confinement in %h/.local/bin and ~/.config/knot, eliminating any need to unlock or manage OSTree deployments.
ostree.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Stock SteamOS baseline compatibility: A/B immutable root filesystem locking (/usr read-only); knot-mesh guarantees 100% user-space confinement in %h/.local/bin across both EndeavourOS fleet and stock SteamOS. File citations: tests/test_steamdeck_sidequest.sh:1-49.

pipewire.name: PipeWire
pipewire.high_risk_breaking_triggers: DMA-BUF screencasting buffer sharing failures between KWin and KRdp; PipeWire socket availability under user runtime directory. File citations: ARCHITECTURE.md:192.

wireplumber.name: WirePlumber
wireplumber.high_risk_breaking_triggers: WirePlumber 0.4 -> 0.5 Lua to SPA/JSON configuration schema rewrite; session policy stalls.

kde_cli_tools.name: kde-cli-tools
kde_cli_tools.high_risk_breaking_triggers: kwriteconfig5 vs kwriteconfig6 binary naming in Plasma 6; config key group writing in ~/.config/krdpserverrc and krdcrc. File citations: PKGBUILD:18, core/modules/vmon.sh:201-205, 231-234, 276-287.

qt6_tools.name: qt6-tools (qdbus6)
qt6_tools.high_risk_breaking_triggers: qdbus binary missing in Arch Qt6; qdbus6 required for all D-Bus queries to KWin, KDE Connect, Klipper, and ScreenSaver. File citations: core/modules/kdeconnect.sh:19-28, core/modules/vmon.sh:304, bin/knot-vmon-keepalive:162.

wl_clipboard.name: wl-clipboard
wl_clipboard.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Wayland compositor access requirement (WAYLAND_DISPLAY); fallback to Klipper D-Bus when absent. File citations: core/modules/kdeconnect.sh:30-89.

libnotify.name: libnotify
libnotify.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Headless execution fails without active notification daemon on DBus. File citations: PKGBUILD:23, core/modules/deskflow.sh.

curl.name: curl
curl.high_risk_breaking_triggers: HTTP/2 and TLS 1.3 negotiation; install.sh bootstrap download pipe. File citations: install.sh:5, core/modules/hub.sh:220.

git.name: git
git.high_risk_breaking_triggers: git-worktree lockfile contention and orphan worktrees; safe.directory ownership checks across mesh. File citations: install.sh:36, 75, core/gitops.sh:1-450, bin/knot:worktree.

github_cli.name: GitHub CLI (gh)
github_cli.high_risk_breaking_triggers: gh release create and gh release edit pre-release flag changes; token authentication scopes.

spectacle.name: Spectacle
spectacle.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Crashes with SIGABRT over headless SSH without QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen.

btrfs_progs.name: btrfs-progs
btrfs_progs.historical_notes: Btrfs filesystem administration utilities (btrfs-progs). Used for host partition setup and workstation snapshotting, but out of product runtime scope as Knot Mesh does not perform filesystem-level mutations.
btrfs_progs.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Subvolume layout variations across root partition subvolids; workstation snapshot automation.

timeshift.name: Timeshift
timeshift.historical_notes: System snapshot utility requiring root execution. Maintained solely for manual developer workstation rollback and disaster recovery; not integrated into Knot Mesh runtime automation.
timeshift.high_risk_breaking_triggers: Root execution requirement; external developer workstation maintenance only.

webkit2gtk_4_1.name: webkit2gtk-4.1
webkit2gtk_4_1.high_risk_breaking_triggers: WebKit IPC crashes if webview hardware acceleration fails on Wayland; required for Knot Kafe Tauri v2 desktop container. File citations: PKGBUILD:24.

gtk3.name: GTK 3
gtk3.high_risk_breaking_triggers: System tray icon protocol differences between AppIndicator and StatusNotifierItem under KDE Plasma 6. File citations: PKGBUILD:25.
